description: This file defines the Configuration class within the Aws\ClientSideMonitoring namespace. It implements configuration management for client-side monitoring, including setting and retrieving properties like client ID, enable status, host, and port, with validation logic.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: A class representing the configuration settings for AWS Client Side Monitoring, including properties for client ID, enabled flag, host, and port, with methods to access these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Configuration class, initializes properties with provided values, validates port as integer, and converts enabled flag to boolean.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the client side monitoring is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
